historical_revision_role: Local pre-rebase commit containing the exact final source and test bytes reviewed by applied-fix-review.md and final-review.md. It was not pushed; its object is not required for the published reconstruction below.

reconstruction.method: Run the commands together as one parenthesized Bash block. Load base_revision into a temporary Git index, apply the published patch with git apply --cached, and read the resulting index blobs. The subshell scopes GIT_INDEX_FILE and its exit trap removes only the temporary index; the working tree and normal index are unchanged. Both product changes are in this patch; historical preflight.py and schema.py are unchanged from the base.
reconstruction.observed_result: Reconstructed bytes for all four files below equal the local pre-rebase revision exactly. The commands.py reconstructed blob is 5510b96b304e59b399bb93a11a081a2fc0b3136a, which supplies the historical line numbering in both reports.

mapping_validation: Each historical commands.py line-range block occurs exactly once, byte-for-byte, at its mapped range in rebased_pr_revision. In particular, the scaffold-help citation 3784-3789 maps to 4137-4142.

independent_verification.checks: Independently reconstructed the specified base plus published patch in a temporary Git index. All four files matched the pre-rebase revision, Git blob IDs and SHA-256 values. All six mapped ranges matched uniquely byte-for-byte. Both report prefixes matched HEAD exactly, with only appended source-revision notes. The ordinary index and watched files were unchanged by verification.
independent_verification.limitations: Verification used the published commit objects available locally; it did not separately query GitHub, rerun tests, or re-review product behavior.

limits: Historical source references describe the pre-rebase review state, not floating line numbers on the latest branch head. The rebased ranges are pinned to rebased_pr_revision, not a promise about future commits.

The original review bodies, raw command captures, plan/source pins and execution ledger are preserved. Linked report annotations explain this map; they do not retroactively claim a new independent review or rerun.

This reconstruction restores the cited source and test files, not the entire old checkout or its dependency environment. It does not rerun the captured tests or establish model-backed custom-job behavior.
